title: Remediate Dependabot sprintf-js DoS alert via js-yaml override
goal: Remove the vulnerable transitive npm dependency sprintf-js@1.0.3 (GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c / CVE-2026-97058, denial of service through unbounded precision specifiers) from the frontend dependency graph so Dependabot alert #43 closes without upgrading unrelated packages.

out: Removing nyc or vite-plugin-istanbul (both remain in use for coverage)
Backend Go module graph (the advisory is npm-only)
Dismissing the alert without removing the vulnerable dependency
Upgrading unrelated npm packages that a full lockfile re-resolve would have floated

acceptanceCriteria: npm ls sprintf-js reports an empty tree for the frontend workspace.
frontend/package-lock.json no longer contains a sprintf-js, nested argparse@1 or esprima entry.
npm ci --dry-run accepts the lockfile as in sync with package.json and only removes the four orphaned packages.
@istanbuljs/load-nyc-config still resolves js-yaml and parses a YAML config through the hoisted js-yaml v5.
GitHub Dependabot alert #43 transitions out of the open state once main carries the change.

runtimeEvidence: Before/after Dependabot alert snapshot for alert #43
load-nyc-config YAML parse result through the hoisted js-yaml v5
